en: No more flicker: boot screens and every time/date update are drawn off-screen and swapped in whole
Rain radar and plane cards use a new low-memory format: no more 'No memory for GIF'
Choose which Bureau of Meteorology radar to watch (Album & radar page)
Smoother radar loop, steadier memory (face stays loaded)
